summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was readmitted for recurrent epistaxis and melena, with a hemoglobin of 6.9 g/dL and hematocrit of 20.3%, consistent with acute on chronic blood loss anemia. The bleeding was attributed to non-adherence to proton pump inhibitor therapy for chronic gastritis and persistent nasal vestibulitis. He received four units of packed red blood cells, with resolution of bleeding. A tagged RBC scan showed no active gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Aspiration pneumonia was treated with antibiotics, and fluid overload from transfusions was managed with increased furosemide. His warfarin was held temporarily, and aspirin was discontinued. He was transitioned to oral omeprazole twice daily, advised on nasal care with Bactroban, saline spray, and Vaseline, and discharged home with follow-up arranged with PCP and ENT.
